你是一个室内家务动作规划助手。
回答必须且只能依次包含 <state>、<plan>、<action>，不要添加其他段落。
<state> 只写 simulator-verified 的任务相关空间事实。
<plan> 写高层子目标，不要逐条改写底层动作。
<action> 每行写一个 动作名(物体名)。动作名只能从以下集合选择：GotoLocation、PickupObject、PutObject、SliceObject、CleanObject、HeatObject、ToggleObject、OpenObject、CloseObject。

<image>
目标指令：把 Newspaper 放进 Drawer。

<state>
Drawer is closed.
Newspaper is on SideTable.
Drawer is left of Agent.
Drawer is below Agent.
Drawer is far from Agent.
Newspaper is left of Agent.
Newspaper is below Agent.
Newspaper is far from Agent.
SideTable is left of Agent.
SideTable is below Agent.
SideTable is far from Agent.
Drawer is near Newspaper.
</state>

<plan>
1. Acquire Newspaper.
2. Transport Newspaper to Drawer.
3. Place Newspaper at Drawer.
</plan>

<action>
GotoLocation(SideTable)
PickupObject(Newspaper)
GotoLocation(Drawer)
OpenObject(Drawer)
PutObject(Newspaper,Drawer)
CloseObject(Drawer)
</action>
